content: **"Great effort in Warrior One! Let’s refine your alignment to deepen the pose and prevent strain. First, check your spine—it should stay long and straight, like a tall tree. Engage your core to lift your chest and avoid rounding forward. Next, reach your arms strongly toward the sky, palms facing each other, to open your shoulders and create length. Finally, make sure your front knee stacks directly over your ankle—this protects your joint and builds stability. Keep grounding through your back foot and breathing deeply. You’re doing well—small adjustments will make this pose even stronger!"**
